abstract: Maintains clearances for overhead power line lifting and railway level crossings
system_message:
You are the Infrastructure and utilities coordinator (UTIL), responsible for maintaining clearances for overhead power line lifting and railway level crossings, as well as reviewing aerial telecommunications line survey data.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains clearances for overhead power line lifting and railway level crossings（XING）
information_points.content:
UTIL-XING-DHF：For the A66 Stainmore Pass Corridor, overhead high-voltage utility escort approval is granted for overhead 132 kV and 275 kV power line crossings with authorization of dedicated lineworker bucket-truck escort teams for live conductor lifting. Furthermore, railway level crossing transit clearance is granted across all active railway level crossings intersecting the route under formal rail safety sign-off for grounding clearance and track circuit immunity.
UTIL-XING-8AL：For the M62 Trans-Pennine Heavy Haul Route, overhead high-voltage utility escort approval is granted for overhead 132 kV and 275 kV power line crossings, authorizing dedicated lineworker bucket-truck escort teams for live conductor lifting. In addition, railway level crossing transit clearance is granted across all active railway level crossings intersecting the route, confirming formal rail safety sign-off for grounding clearance and track circuit immunity.
UTIL-XING-DBV：For the A69 Tyne Valley Bypass Route, overhead high-voltage utility escort approval is not granted for overhead 132 kV and 275 kV power line crossings, lacking authorization of dedicated lineworker bucket-truck escort teams for live conductor lifting. However, railway level crossing transit clearance is granted across all active railway level crossings intersecting the route, satisfying formal rail safety sign-off for grounding clearance and track circuit immunity.

information_points.title: Telecommunications line survey（FIBER）
information_points.content:
UTIL-FIBER-RSI：For the M62 Trans-Pennine Heavy Haul Route, the telecommunications line survey records an aerial fiber overhead clearance of 5.8 m, measured as the minimum static vertical clearance between ground and conductor sag for the lowest span aerial telecom cabling over public highways.
UTIL-FIBER-0LM：For the A66 Stainmore Pass Corridor, the telecommunications line survey identifies an aerial fiber overhead clearance of 6.6 m across the lowest span aerial telecom cabling over public highways based on minimum static vertical clearance between ground and conductor sag.
UTIL-FIBER-7X8：For the A69 Tyne Valley Bypass Route, the telecommunications line survey indicates an aerial fiber overhead clearance of 6.2 m for the lowest span aerial telecom cabling over public highways, representing the minimum static vertical clearance between ground and conductor sag.
